description: Triggers for changing or modernizing existing (brownfield, legacy) code safely: inventory and dependency mapping, value/risk classification, retire/retain/upgrade/re-platform/migrate decisions, characterization tests (CHAR-n) before touching untested code, current-state research with cited evidence, expand-contract schema migrations, strangler cutovers and migration runbooks

queries.query: We inherited a legacy monolith with no tests. Build an inventory and decide what to retire, upgrade or migrate
Write characterization tests that pin what this untested pricing function does today before I change it
Rename a column in the orders table without downtime — expand and contract, please
Plan a strangler fig migration from the old quotes endpoint to the new pricing service
Research how invoice rounding works in this codebase today and cite file and line for every claim
Our app runs on Python 3.6 and Angular 1.x; which parts should we re-platform first and in what order?
Map the dependencies between our services and the shared database tables before we split the monolith
Write a cutover runbook for moving reports from the old database to the new one, with rollback
Can we delete the old fax export job? Nobody seems to use it
Run old and new billing side by side and compare outputs before switching traffic
Set up the AGENTS.md block and the code map for this repository so agents can start working
Implement task T4 from the plan test-first, red then green
The nightly job crashes with a null pointer since yesterday's deploy; find the root cause
Write the spec with acceptance criteria for a new CSV export feature
Compare Kafka and RabbitMQ for our new event bus and write an ADR
Set up the staged rollout with feature flags and rehearse the rollback for release 3.2
Design the acceptance tests for spec 012 from the approved acceptance criteria
Research the market for AI note-taking apps and summarize competitors with sources
